battle.name: 俄格戰爭
battle.theater: 南奧塞梯亞與茨欣瓦利戰線
battle.brief: 2008年8月7日，喬治亞軍進攻南奧塞梯亞並炮擊茨欣瓦利，俄軍第五十八集團軍當夜越過洛奇通道參戰。卡面的T-72中型坦克正是雙方共同的裝備骨架：俄軍以坦克縱隊封死茨欣瓦利，喬治亞的T-72則在市區與近郊大量被擊毀或繳獲。五日戰事以歐洲聯盟斡旋停火收場，俄軍其後承認南奧塞梯亞獨立。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主力中型坦克，編入坦克部隊，負責正面突破、攻堅與伴隨步兵作戰，並提供直接的火力支援。

countries: 俄羅斯聯邦、其承認的南奧塞梯亞武裝與阿布哈茲武裝為一方，喬治亞國家武裝為另一方。俄方由北高加索軍區統籌，南奧塞梯亞方向以第五十八集團軍為主力，配第四十二近衛摩托化步兵師、空降兵、總參謀部特種部隊同車臣「東方」與「西方」營；阿布哈茲方向有第七近衛空降師、第七十六近衛航空空降師同黑海艦隊。戰前俄羅斯以維和部隊身分在南奧塞梯亞駐紮約五百人、在阿布哈茲約一千六百人，戰前數月又把阿布哈茲駐軍增至二千人以上。喬治亞方面由第比利斯指揮南部戰區，部署第2、第3、第4軍事基地同內務部特種部隊，8月8日凌晨第3、第4旅自兩翼向茨欣瓦利推進，另有受俄方武裝的哥薩克與阿布哈茲特種部隊參與。實際交火集中於茨欣瓦利市區、洛奇通道與通往祖爾克蒂的公路沿線，阿布哈茲方向則在科多里峽谷另開戰線。
countriesEn: Russia, the South Ossetian forces it recognised, and the Abkhaz forces fought the armed forces of Georgia. On the Russian side the operation was run by the North Caucasus Military District: in South Ossetia the main effort fell on the 58th Combined Arms Army, supported by the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division, airborne troops, GRU special forces and the Chechen battalions Vostok and Zapad, with the 4th Air Force Command providing air support; in Abkhazia Russia committed the 7th Guards Airborne Division, the 76th Guards Air Assault Division and units of the Black Sea Fleet. Before the war Russian peacekeepers stood at about 500 men in South Ossetia and about 1,600 in Abkhazia, and the Abkhaz garrison had already been raised above 2,000 in the preceding months. Georgia, for its part, directed the southern theatre from Tbilisi through its 2nd, 3rd and 4th military bases and the special forces of the Ministry of Internal Affairs; in the early hours of 8 August the 3rd and 4th brigades moved on the two flanks of Tskhinvali, while armed Cossacks and Abkhaz special units fought on the same side as the separatists. The actual fighting was concentrated in the town of Tskhinvali, on the road through the Roki tunnel and along the highway to Tskhumi, while the Abkhaz forces opened a second front in the Kodori Gorge.
people: 俄羅斯總統德米特里·梅德韋夫在8月8日下午召開安全會議常務委員會緊急會議並決定出兵，當時俄國總理為弗拉基米爾·普京，國防部長阿納托利·謝爾久科夫，總參謀長尼古拉·馬卡羅夫。戰區指揮由北高加索軍區同第五十八集團軍負責，第五十八集團軍司令阿納托利·赫魯廖夫少將在戰後聲稱所部原本可以攻入第比利斯，只是未接到命令；佔領軍指揮官維亞切斯拉夫·鮑里索夫少將在戈里宣布軍警共同接管。喬治亞方面，總統米哈伊爾·薩卡什維利在8月7日晚宣布單方面停火並下令「不反擊」，其後仍批准攻擊茨欣瓦利；總理拉多·古爾格尼澤、國防部長達維特·凱澤拉什維利與總參謀長扎扎·戈加瓦主持南部戰區的軍事行動，外長亞歷山大·洛馬亞負責外交斡旋。南奧塞梯亞總統埃杜阿爾德·科科伊蒂與阿布哈茲總統謝爾蓋·巴加普分別代表兩個分離主義政權，並在8月14日簽署停火方案。停火由輪值歐盟理事國主席、法國總統尼古拉·薩科齊斡旋，美國國務卿康多莉扎·賴斯於8月15日抵達第比利斯見證薩卡什維利簽字。
peopleEn: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev convened an emergency session of the Security Council on the afternoon of 8 August and decided on intervention; the prime minister at the time was Vladimir Putin, the defence minister Anatoly Serdyukov and the chief of the general staff Nikolai Makarov. Theatre command rested with the North Caucasus Military District and the 58th Combined Arms Army. Anatoly Khrulyov, commander of the 58th Army, stated after the war that his troops could have taken Tbilisi had he been given the order, while Vyacheslav Borisov, commander of the occupying force, announced in Gori that army and police would run the town together. On the Georgian side President Mikheil Saakashvili announced a unilateral ceasefire and a no-response order on the evening of 7 August, yet still approved the attack on Tskhinvali; Prime Minister Lado Gurgenidze, Defence Minister Davit Kezerashvili and Chief of the General Staff Zaza Gogava directed the southern theatre, while Foreign Minister Alexandre Lomaia handled the diplomatic channel. Eduard Kokoity, president of South Ossetia, and Sergei Bagapsh, president of Abkhazia, represented the two separatist administrations and both signed the peace plan on 14 August. The ceasefire was brokered by Nicolas Sarkozy, then rotating president of the EU Council, and US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice flew to Tbilisi on 15 August to witness Saakashvili signing.
kits: 卡面的T-72中型坦克是這場戰爭裝備層面的真正主軸。T-72於1973年定型，採用低矮車體、複合裝甲與自動裝填機，是蘇聯陸軍編入坦克部隊、負責正面突破與攻堅的主力裝備；其改進型T-72B在一九八〇年代換上125毫米滑膛炮與熱成像瞄具，正是二〇〇八年兩軍在茨欣瓦利周邊實際交手的型號。喬治亞在蘇聯解體時繼承了191輛T-72，其中75輛部署到南奧塞梯亞，這批經一九九〇年代陸續交付、逐步加裝首上反應裝甲與熱成像瞄具的坦克，是格陸軍唯一可以信賴的裝甲突擊力量，但多數乘員訓練不足、備份件短缺。俄軍方面，第五十八集團軍所屬摩步師與空降兵同樣以T-72系列為裝甲骨幹，配合第四十二近衛摩托化步兵師沿洛奇通道展開。T-72的設計特性直接決定了打法：低矮車體與熱成像瞄具令它在山區道路與夜戰中難以被發現，一百二十五毫米滑膛炮在兩千米射距離上仍對喬治亞裝甲車保有壓倒優勢，自動裝填機讓它在狹窄山路中不必停下填彈。其他裝備方面，喬治亞軍有154輛步兵戰車、66輛裝甲輸送車、152毫米DANA自行榴砲與BM-21「冰雹」火箭砲，戰敗後有二十五門牽引砲、兩輛DANA自行榴砲、六輛2S7「花園」自行火炮與一批防空裝置被俄軍繳獲，另有塞納基第二步兵旅基地的一千七百二十八支槍械被成批接收。俄軍則出動Su-25與Su-24攻擊機、武裝直升機、122毫米自行榴砲與BM-21火箭砲，戰後清點估計損失三輛坦克、至少二十輛裝甲車與三十二輛非裝甲車。雙方同出一源的蘇制家底，令這場戰爭表面是兩國交鋒，骨子裡卻是同一種坦克在兩種訓練水平下的對照。
kitsEn: The T-72 main battle tank on the card face is the real axis of the equipment question in this war. The T-72 was type-approved in 1973 with a low hull, composite armour and an autoloader, and it was the Soviet Army's principal tank for frontal breakthroughs and assaults; its improved T-72B, fitted in the 1980s with a 125 mm smoothbore gun and thermal sighting, is the version that actually met in battle around Tskhinvali in 2008. Georgia inherited 191 T-72s on the breakup of the Soviet Union and deployed 75 of them to South Ossetia. Delivered piecemeal through the 1990s and gradually fitted with appliqué armour and thermal sights, they were the only reliable armoured striking force the Georgian army possessed, although most crews were untrained and spares were scarce. On the Russian side the motor rifle divisions and airborne formations of the 58th Combined Arms Army likewise built their armoured striking force on the T-72 series, working with the 42nd Guards Motor Rifle Division as it came through the Roki tunnel. The design of the T-72 dictated the tactics: its low profile and thermal sights made it hard to spot on mountain roads and at night, its 125 mm smoothbore gun retained a decisive advantage over Georgian armour at engagement ranges beyond two thousand metres, and its autoloader let it fight in narrow defiles without stopping to reload. On the Georgian side the inventory of 154 infantry fighting vehicles, 66 armoured personnel carriers, 152 mm DANA self-propelled howitzers and BM-21 Grad rocket launchers was left behind after the defeat, along with twenty-five towed guns, two DANAs, six 2S7 Pion self-propelled guns and a batch of air defence systems; 1,728 small arms seized at the Senaki Second Infantry Brigade base were taken in bulk. Russia flew Su-25 and Su-24 strike aircraft, armed helicopters, 122 mm self-propelled howitzers and BM-21 Grad launchers, and its post-war count put the ground losses at three tanks, at least twenty armoured vehicles and thirty-two unarmoured vehicles. Both sides drawing on the same Soviet stock meant that, on the surface, this was a clash between two states; in substance it was one tank measured against two very different standards of training.
tactics: 這場戰爭的節奏由兩條山地公路決定。8月7日深夜，喬治亞炮兵先以煙幕彈開場，十五分鐘後全面炮擊南奧塞梯亞陣地；8月8日凌晨四時，第3、第4旅自兩翼向茨欣瓦利推進，內務部特種部隊攻入市中心，上午十時已有一千五百名步兵進入市區，但未能封住通往洛奇通道的古普塔橋與賈瓦基地的道路，傍晚即撤出市中心。俄軍的反制是典型的縱隊加火力準備：8月8日莫斯科時間十六時左右，第五十八集團軍兩個重型裝甲縱隊通過洛奇隧道與賈瓦，沿公路向茨欣瓦利推進，十七時前後坦克縱隊完成對城市的包圍，同日俄空軍在上午十時後開始大規模出擊，一日之內飛行六十三架次。俄軍打法是裝甲縱隊伴隨摩托化步兵，T-72擔任先頭，榴砲與火箭砲在行軍縱隊前方展開火力準備，空中由Su-24、Su-25打擊格方陣地與交通線；代價是縱隊長度拉長、補給線脆弱，前期屢遭側射與道路阻擊。八月十日起俄軍改以兩路縱隊平行推進，一路由祖爾克蒂方向直取茨欣瓦利，另一路沿茨欣瓦利至茨庫米公路向東切斷退路，把守軍分割在市區與東南村落之間。阿布哈茲方向同時在科多里峽谷開闢第二戰線，格方守軍腹背受敵。停火生效後，俄軍8月22日撤出伊戈埃蒂，9月13日撤出西部喬治亞的塞納基與霍比，10月8日退出緩衝區，交由歐盟核查團接管。
tacticsEn: The rhythm of this war was set by two mountain highways. Late on 7 August Georgian artillery opened with smoke rounds and, after a fifteen-minute pause, bombarded South Ossetian positions; at 04:00 on 8 August the 3rd and 4th brigades advanced on both flanks of Tskhinvali and special forces of the Interior Ministry drove into the town centre, where 1,500 infantrymen were in place by 10:00, but they failed to close the Gupta bridge and the road to the Roki tunnel and the Java base, and left the centre in the evening. The Russian counterstroke was classic column-and-preparation: at about 16:00 Moscow time on 8 August two heavy armoured columns of the 58th Army passed the Roki tunnel and Java and moved down the road to Tskhinvali, and by roughly 17:00 Russian tank columns had closed around the city, while the air force began large-scale strikes after 10:00 and flew sixty-three sorties that day. Russian doctrine put armoured columns in company with motor rifle infantry, T-72s in the van, howitzers and rocket launchers opening fire in front of the moving columns, and Su-24 and Su-25 aircraft working over Georgian positions and lines of communication. The price was long columns and a thin line of supply, and early movements were repeatedly hit from the flanks and blocked on the roads. From 10 August the Russians switched to two parallel columns, one striking straight for Tskhinvali from the Tskhumi side, the other moving east along the Tskhinvali-Tskhumi road to cut the retreat and split the defenders between the town and the villages to the south-east. In Abkhazia a second front was opened in the Kodori Gorge, so Georgian troops were taken from both sides. After the ceasefire held, Russian forces withdrew from Igoeti on 22 August, from Senaki and Khobi in western Georgia on 13 September, and from the buffer zones on 8 October, handing them over to the EU monitoring mission.
data: 可核對的數字集中在裝備與損失兩端。格魯吉亞方面，戰前共有191輛T-72坦克、154輛步兵戰車、16輛偵察車、66輛裝甲輸送車與86輛履帶式裝甲車，其中75輛T-72投入南奧塞梯亞方向；俄軍在茨欣瓦利一帶摧毀至少十輛T-72，戰後自格軍繳獲的T-72總數達65輛，約佔格方總數三分之一。格方裝備損失包括四十四輛坦克（二十八輛被擊毀、十七輛被繳獲）、二十五門牽引砲、二十五輛步兵戰車、九門自行火炮、六部防空火箭系統與九艘船艇（七艘被擊毀）。俄方損失按格方與獨立觀察員核對為陣亡一百六十三至一百七十人、受傷三百五十四人、失聯三人、被俘三十九人，車輛九十三輛中九十輛被摧毀，四輛坦克、二十輛步兵戰車與五輛裝甲輸送車全毀，六架飛機，其中三架屬同袍誤擊，另有兩架直升機因事故墜毀。俄軍自己的裝備損失估計為三輛坦克、至少二十輛裝甲車與三十二輛非裝甲車。時間上，主要交火集中在8月8日至12日，自7日炮擊至16日簽署停火文件歷時約十日；8月8日一日之內俄空軍出動六十三架次。戰後有報導指俄軍五日戰事的直接開支約一百二十五億盧布，即每日約二十五億盧布。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked sit at the two ends of the ledger, equipment and losses. Georgia entered the war with 191 T-72 tanks, 154 infantry fighting vehicles, 16 reconnaissance vehicles, 66 armoured personnel carriers and 86 tracked armoured cars, of which 75 T-72s were deployed towards South Ossetia. At least ten T-72s were destroyed around Tskhinvali, and Russia seized 65 T-72s after the fighting, about a third of the Georgian total. Georgian equipment losses included 44 tanks (28 destroyed and 17 captured), 25 towed artillery pieces, 25 infantry fighting vehicles, nine self-propelled guns, six surface-to-air missile systems and nine naval vessels (seven destroyed). Russian losses, as counted by Georgian and independent observers, were 163 to 170 killed, 354 wounded, three missing and 39 captured; of 93 vehicles, 90 were destroyed, including four tanks, 20 infantry fighting vehicles and five armoured personnel carriers, along with six aircraft, three of them lost to friendly fire, and two helicopters destroyed in accidents. Russian estimates of their own ground losses put them at three tanks, at least twenty armoured vehicles and thirty-two unarmoured vehicles. In time, the main fighting ran from 8 to 12 August, and ten days separated the opening bombardment on the 7th from the signature of the ceasefire documents on the 16th; the Russian air force flew sixty-three sorties on 8 August alone. After the war, reports put the direct cost of the five-day campaign to Russia at about 12.5 billion roubles, or roughly 2.5 billion roubles a day.
cause: 引爆點是南奧塞梯亞問題在二〇〇四年之後急劇惡化。二〇〇四年，喬治亞軍在尼科茲公路一帶向正在撤退的南奧塞梯亞民兵開火，造成多人死亡；此後喬治亞逐步收緊對南奧塞梯亞地方的控制，二〇〇五年宣布撤走當地全部武裝力量並解散民兵，引發對方抵制；二〇〇八年四月，喬治亞解散南奧塞梯亞地方議會、撤換縣長並派兵接管，同年七月雙方在茨欣瓦利外圍與洛奇隧道再起交火，隧道與縣界哨所屢遭炮擊。8月6日下午，整條前線爆發迫擊砲與炮兵交火；8月7日十九時喬治亞宣布單方面停火並以煙幕彈開場炮擊，民兵隨即還擊，國防部發言人則稱國家決定「恢復憲法秩序」。8月7日深夜第二批俄軍越過洛奇通道的消息，令梅德韋夫在8月8日作出出兵決定。宏觀背景是北約在二〇〇八年四月布加勒斯特峰會確認格魯吉亞的入盟路徑，俄羅斯不願接受一個已倒向北約的鄰國，加上南奧塞梯亞居民持有俄羅斯護照，克里姆林宮需要保住對護照公民的「保護」責任。究竟誰先打響第一槍，雙方說法至今並不一致，多份戰後調查報告的結論互相矛盾。
causeEn: The flashpoint was the rapid deterioration of the South Ossetian question after 2004. In 2004 Georgian troops fired on withdrawing South Ossetian militia near the Nikozi road, killing several people; Georgian control over the region was then tightened, and in 2005 Tbilisi announced that it would withdraw all armed forces and disband the local militia, which the South Ossetians resisted. In April 2008 Georgia dissolved the South Ossetian district council, replaced its head and sent troops to take over; in July the two sides fought again around the approaches to Tskhinvali and the Roki tunnel, and the tunnel and district checkpoints were shelled repeatedly. On the afternoon of 6 August mortars and artillery traded fire along the entire front. On 7 August at 19:00 Georgia announced a unilateral ceasefire and opened with smoke rounds, the militia returned fire, and a defence ministry spokesman said the state had decided to restore constitutional order. Word that a second Russian echelon had crossed the Roki tunnel on the night of 7 August moved Medvedev to the decision to intervene on 8 August. The wider background was the NATO Bucharest summit of April 2008, which confirmed Georgia's path to membership; Russia was unwilling to accept a neighbour already turning towards NATO, and with South Ossetian residents holding Russian passports, the Kremlin needed to keep up a duty of protection towards its own citizens. Who fired the first shot remains disputed, and the conclusions of several post-war investigations contradict one another.
impact: 戰爭把二〇〇八年以前的歐洲安全秩序撕開一道裂縫。這是蘇聯解體後俄羅斯第一次對一個獨立國家動用大規模常規軍力，戰略學界普遍視二〇〇八年八月八日為歐洲安全格局的轉折點。北約的反應被批評為遲緩，歐洲安全與合作組織的框架未能阻止一個主權國的邊界被武力修改；法國與德國等歐洲國家在北約內部反對對俄強硬路線，分歧公開化。俄羅斯則在戰後加強在南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲的駐軍：戰前兩地俄軍分別只有約五百與一千六百人，戰後改以「雙邊軍事合作」名義常駐，並在9月7日承認兩個地區獨立。喬治亞的戰略處境因此急劇惡化：北約入盟前景幾近凍結，與俄羅斯斷交，國內武裝部隊在裝備、人員與指揮體系上的缺陷全部暴露，改革工作延續十多年，直到2015年才啟動代號「綠箭」與「莉安娜」的歐美聯合訓練。戰爭亦成為日後俄羅斯在烏克蘭行動的模板：2014年兼併克里米亞、2022年全面入侵，師法的一整套做法——有限目標、混合兵力、快速縱隊推進、事後以既有條約確認既成事實——都能在2008年的戰術與外交痕跡中找到源頭。
impactEn: The war tore a breach in the European security order as it had stood before 2008. It was the first time since the collapse of the Soviet Union that Russia had used large-scale conventional force against an independent state, and strategic studies commonly treat 8 August 2008 as a turning point in the European security landscape. The NATO response was judged too slow, and the framework of the Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe failed to prevent the border of a sovereign state being altered by force; within NATO, European states such as France and Germany opposed a hard line against Moscow, and the split became public. Russia, for its part, reinforced its military presence in South Ossetia and Abkhazia: before the war the two garrisons numbered only about 500 and 1,600 men, whereas afterwards they were permanent under the label of bilateral military cooperation, and on 7 September Moscow recognised the independence of both territories. Georgia's strategic position deteriorated sharply. Its prospect of NATO membership froze, relations with Moscow were severed, and every weakness of its armed forces in equipment, manning and command became visible; reform ran for more than a decade, and joint European and American training under the code names Green Arrow and Liana only began in 2015. The campaign also became the template for later Russian action in Ukraine: the annexation of Crimea in 2014 and the full-scale invasion of 2022 copied an entire repertoire of limited aims, mixed forces, fast column movement and the confirmation of accomplished facts by treaty afterwards, all of which can be traced to the tactical and diplomatic traces of 2008.
result: 結果是俄方佔盡上風而代價慘烈。南奧塞梯亞全境與茨欣瓦利市區在五個日夜之間被俄軍攻佔，喬治亞失去對該地區的實際控制；俄軍推進至距第比利斯約四十公里的伊戈埃蒂即止步。8月12日梅德韋夫宣布「維和強制」行動結束，與薩科齊共同認可六點方案，14日南奧塞梯亞與阿布哈茲的總統亦簽署，15日薩卡什維利在賴斯見證下簽字，16日梅德韋夫簽署協議，17日宣布自18日起撤軍。8月19日雙方交換俘虜，8月22日俄軍撤出伊戈埃蒂與戈里附近，9月8日再由薩科齊與梅德韋夫簽訂撤軍協議，9月13日撤出塞納基與霍比，10月8日退出緩衝區交由歐盟監察團接管。長期看，格魯吉亞於2009年退出獨立國家聯合體，2011年兩國簽訂邊界條約、確認失去的領土；俄軍則在戰後檢討中承認縱隊作戰、補給與指揮上的問題，並以此推動裝備更新。真正的結局並非一條戰線的勝負，而是兩國關係、歐洲安全架構與格魯吉亞國家命運的長期重塑。
resultEn: The result was an outright Russian success bought at heavy cost. South Ossetia and the town of Tskhinvali were taken by Russian troops within five nights, and Georgia lost effective control of the region; the Russian advance stopped at Igoeti, roughly forty kilometres from Tbilisi. On 12 August Medvedev declared the peace enforcement operation over and endorsed the six-point plan together with Sarkozy; on the 14th the presidents of South Ossetia and Abkhazia also signed, on the 15th Saakashvili signed in the presence of Rice, on the 16th Medvedev signed, and on the 17th withdrawal from the following day was announced. Prisoners were exchanged on 19 August, Russian forces pulled out of Igoeti and the vicinity of Gori on 22 August, a further withdrawal agreement was signed by Sarkozy and Medvedev on 8 September, the forces left Senaki and Khobi on 13 September, and on 8 October they withdrew from the buffer zones and handed them to the EU monitoring mission. In the long run Georgia left the Commonwealth of Independent States in 2009, and in 2011 the two states signed a border treaty confirming the territory Georgia had lost; the Russian military, meanwhile, acknowledged the problems its own review found in column movement, supply and command, and used the campaign to drive rearmament. The true outcome was not the result of one front but the long-term remaking of relations between the two countries, of the European security architecture, and of Georgia's national trajectory.
